cases.name: Nathan Taylor
cases.note: Two different class-of-2029 wrestlers at two schools in the SAME seasons. Dated RankWrestlers records show two complete concurrent chains; the Hopewell 2025 placement does not belong to the Eastern View profile. The 49-lb spread (126 to 175) was the queue's largest and the reason this one was pushed to the front of scrutiny.
